question: The Eravikulam National Park, which emerged as one of the two top-performing protected areas in India in the Management Effectiveness Evaluation (MEE) conducted by the Wildlife Institute of India in June 2025, is home to which of the following species?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nilgiri Tahr**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Eravikulam National Park (ENP)** is situated in the **Devikulam Taluk** of **Idukki district** in **Kerala**, along the high ranges of the **Southern Western Ghats**.
 
• It is famously known as the natural habitat of the **Nilgiri Tahr** (***Nilgiritragus hylocrius***), an endangered mountain goat that is endemic to the **Western Ghats**. ***Hence, the correct answer is Nilgiri Tahr.***
 
• In **June 2025**, the park was recognized by the **Wildlife Institute of India (WII)** in its **Management Effectiveness Evaluation (MEE)** report as one of the top-performing protected areas in the country due to its excellence in biodiversity conservation and administrative efficiency.
 
• The park houses **Anamudi**, which is the **highest peak** in **South India**, standing at an elevation of **2,695 metres**.
 
• Originally established as a **wildlife sanctuary** in **1975** primarily to protect the declining population of the **Nilgiri Tahr**, it was elevated to the status of a **National Park** in **1978**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Vegetation and Flora:**
 
 
• The park's ecosystem is characterized by **high-altitude grasslands** interspersed with **Shola forests** (stunted tropical montane forests).
 
• It is one of the primary sites for the blooming of the **Neelakurinji** (***Strobilanthes kunthiana***), a flower that carpets the hills in blue once every **12 years**.
 
 
 
• **Faunal Diversity:**
 
 
• Apart from the flagship **Nilgiri Tahr**, the park is home to other species like the **Gaur**, **Indian Muntjac**, **Sambar Deer**, **Golden Jackal**, and **Leopard**.
 
• The **Lion-tailed Macaque** is another endemic species of the **Western Ghats**, but it is more commonly associated with the **Silent Valley National Park** rather than the grassland-dominant terrain of **Eravikulam**.
 
 
 
• **Hydrography:**
 
 
• The park serves as a major catchment area for several perennial streams that feed into the **Periyar River** and the **Chalakuddy River**.
 
 
 
• **Tourism:**
 
 
• The **Rajamala** region is the designated tourism zone within the park where visitors are allowed to witness the **Nilgiri Tahr** at close quarters.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Conservation Status of Nilgiri Tahr:**
 
 
• The **Nilgiri Tahr** is listed as **Endangered** on the **IUCN Red List**.
 
• It is protected under **Schedule I** of the **Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972**, providing it the highest level of legal protection in **India**.
 
• The **Government of Tamil Nadu** has also launched **Project Nilgiri Tahr** (the first of its kind) to protect its state animal, which shares its habitat with **Kerala's** high-altitude zones.
 
 
 
• **Management Effectiveness Evaluation (MEE):**
 
 
• **MEE** is a global framework used by the **National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA)** and **WII** to assess how well protected areas are being managed.
 
• The **2025** evaluation highlights **Eravikulam's** success in maintaining a healthy "population-to-habitat" ratio and mitigating human-wildlife conflict.
